_comment: Copy this file into your MCP client configuration and edit both absolute paths. Both paths are required and neither has a safe default you should rely on: --state-file names the PRIVATE credential file (it must live OUTSIDE this repository), and the args[0] path names this checkout's adapter entry point.

airadio-local-emulator._comment: For local testing against a loopback station only. --allow-local-http permits plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1, localhost and ::1 and nothing else; it never opens a remote host.
